findings.description: User input from request.args is interpolated directly into a SQL query, allowing an attacker to read or modify arbitrary rows.
findings.remediation: Use a parameterized query (cursor.execute with placeholders) instead of string interpolation.
findings.title: SQL injection in user lookup

findings.description: The session cookie is set without the Secure flag, so it can be sent over plain HTTP on networks that allow downgrade.
findings.remediation: Set Secure=True (and HttpOnly) when creating the session cookie.
findings.title: Session cookie missing Secure flag

findings.description: Error responses include a full stack trace, which leaks internal file paths and library versions.
findings.remediation: Return a generic error message to clients and log the stack trace server-side.
findings.title: Stack trace exposed in error response
